proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ M _
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra h0
    have := (IsLocalization.toLocalizationMap M S).nontrivial h0
    exact not_subsingleton S h
  · intro h
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S 0) := IsLocalization.map_units S (⟨0, h⟩ : M)
    rw [map_zero] at hu
    exact isUnit_zero_iff.1 hu |> subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R), IsLocalization M S → (Subsingleton S ↔ (0 : R) ∈ M)
